name: mutual-visibility-workspace
description: Workspace tooling for the mutual astronomical visibility web project

scripts.dev:api: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project backend ruff check backend/app backend/tests
scripts.format:check: uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend/app backend/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: uv run --project backend python -m pytest backend/tests -q
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
